nodes.name: Déclencheur
nodes.notes: Appelé par le bot pour chaque message. Reçoit telegram_user_id, chat_type et text.

parameters.query:
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.full_name, u.role, u.organization_id,
       o.name AS organization_name
FROM users u
JOIN organizations o ON o.id = u.organization_id
WHERE u.telegram_user_id = $1 AND u.is_active
LIMIT 1;
